heading: Liji 12 · Ming Tang Wei 明堂位 · The Places In The Hall Of Distinction · Ming Tang Wei 17 … Ming Tang Wei 34

items.text: Maintain the ancestral temple from generation to generation.
items.quote: The temple of the duke of Lû was maintained from generation to generation like that of (king) Wan.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship is idolatry; Christ alone is mediator.

work: The Places In The Hall Of Distinction
heading: Liji 12 · Ming Tang Wei 明堂位 · The Places In The Hall Of Distinction · Ming Tang Wei 1 … Ming Tang Wei 16

items.text: Sacrifice to the departed ancestor from generation to generation with the ceremonies and music proper to a son of Heaven.
items.quote: should sacrifice to the duke of Kâu with the ceremonies and music proper at a sacrifice by the son of Heaven.
items.conflict: Ancestor worship conflicts with the exclusive worship of God (Exod. 20:3-5).

items.text: Assist her husband in the sacrificial rites, performing her own proper duties.
items.quote: his wife brought in the stands for the dishes. Each one discharged the duty proper to him or her.

items.text: When the heir is young, govern on his behalf as regent, and then restore the rule to him.
items.quote: the duke took the seat of the son of Heaven, and governed the kingdom.
